results.question: What is our total revenue?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided';
results.answer: Your total revenue for the period between October 2025 and September 2026 is $3,321,930.71 AUD. This figure includes all completed sales but excludes any orders that were marked as voided in your records.
results.assumptions: Total revenue is defined as the sum of the 'total' column for all non-voided orders across the entire dataset (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30).

results.question: How much revenue did we make in December 2025?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS gross_revenue FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') < '2026-01-01 00:00:00';
results.answer: You made $350,341.05 in revenue during December 2025. This figure represents the total of all non-voided orders processed during that month. Please note that this total assumes all transactions were successfully captured and recorded in your system by the end of the month.
results.assumptions: Revenue is defined as the sum of orders.total for non-voided orders. The date range is restricted to December 2025 in the Australia/Sydney timezone.

results.question: What was our revenue in each month?
results.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney')::date AS month, ROUND(SUM(total)::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
results.answer: Your monthly revenue ranged from a low of $186,309.58 in February 2026 to a high of $367,315.71 in June 2026. These figures represent the total sales for each month between October 2025 and September 2026, excluding any orders that were voided.
results.assumptions: Revenue is defined as the sum of order totals for non-voided orders, attributed to the month the order was placed in Sydney time. Data covers 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30.

results.question: Which month had the highest revenue, and how much was it?
results.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney')::date AS month, ROUND(SUM(total)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
results.answer: June 2026 was your highest revenue month, with a total of $367,315.71 AUD. This figure includes all non-voided orders placed during that month based on Sydney time.
results.assumptions: Revenue is defined as the sum of order totals for non-voided orders, attributed to the month the order was placed in Sydney time. The data period is 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30.

results.question: How much revenue came from each sales channel?
results.sql: SELECT l.type AS sales_channel, ROUND(SUM(o.total)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN locations l ON o.location_id = l.location_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY l.type ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
results.answer: Your online sales generated $2,070,833.88, while your in-store point-of-sale transactions brought in $1,251,096.83. These figures represent the total revenue from all non-voided orders. Please note that this data assumes all orders were correctly categorized by location type at the time of purchase.
results.assumptions: Revenue is defined as the sum of orders.total for all non-voided orders, attributed to the date the order was placed. Sales channels are derived from the location type (online vs pos).

results.question: What is the revenue for each store location?
results.sql: SELECT l.name AS location_name, ROUND(SUM(o.total)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN locations l ON o.location_id = l.location_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
results.answer: The Online Store generated $2,070,833.88, the Surry Hills Boutique earned $755,981.28, and the Newtown Boutique brought in $495,115.55. These figures represent total revenue from non-voided orders between October 1, 2025, and September 30, 2026.
results.assumptions: Revenue is defined as the sum of order totals for non-voided orders, attributed to the location where the sale occurred. Data covers the full period from 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30.

results.question: How much revenue did we make last month?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(total) AS gross_revenue FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') >= '2026-08-01' AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') < '2026-09-01';
results.answer: You made $282,129.97 in revenue during August 2026. This total includes all non-voided orders processed throughout the month.
results.assumptions: Last month is defined as August 2026, given the current date is 2026-09-30. Revenue is defined as the sum of order totals for non-voided orders.

results.question: How much revenue did our dresses bring in?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) AS total_dress_revenue FROM order_lines ol JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id JOIN products p ON v.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE LOWER(p.product_type) = 'dress' AND o.financial_status <> 'voided';
results.answer: Your dresses brought in a total revenue of $542,898.65 AUD. This figure represents the sum of all non-voided sales after discounts were applied. Please note that this total only includes items specifically categorized as 'dress' in your inventory system.
results.assumptions: Revenue is defined as the sum of line-level totals (unit_price * quantity - line_discount) for all non-voided orders. I have filtered for products where the product_type is 'dress' (case-insensitive).

results.question: What is our net revenue after refunds?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.total) - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided'
results.answer: Your net revenue for the period between October 2025 and September 2026 is $3,205,298.79 AUD. This figure accounts for all non-voided order totals minus the value of processed refunds. Please note that this calculation assumes all voided transactions were correctly excluded from the initial sales data.
results.assumptions: Net revenue is calculated as the sum of all non-voided order totals minus the sum of all refund amounts. The data period is 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30.

results.question: What was our revenue in each of the last 3 months?
results.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney')::date AS month, ROUND(SUM(total)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' AND created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' >= '2026-07-01' AND created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney' < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC
results.answer: Your revenue for the last three months was $342,251.10 in July, $282,129.97 in August, and $278,068.87 in September. These figures represent the total sales from non-voided orders for each month.
results.assumptions: The 'last 3 months' are defined as July, August, and September 2026, based on the current date of 2026-09-30. Revenue is defined as the sum of order totals for non-voided orders.

results.question: How did revenue during the EOFY sale (19 June to 5 July 2026) compare to the same number of days immediately before it?
results.sql: WITH periods AS (SELECT 'EOFY' AS period, '2026-06-19'::date AS start_date, '2026-07-05'::date AS end_date UNION ALL SELECT 'Pre-EOFY', '2026-06-02'::date, '2026-06-18'::date), revenue_data AS (SELECT p.period, SUM(o.total) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN periods p ON (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney')::date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY p.period) SELECT period, ROUND(total_revenue::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM revenue_data ORDER BY period DESC
results.assumptions: The EOFY sale period is defined as 2026-06-19 to 2026-07-05 (17 days). The comparison period is the 17 days immediately preceding it, 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-18. Revenue is defined as the sum of order totals for non-voided orders.
